::: {#exm-hypotheses-wcgs}
#### Cholesterol and CHD in the WCGS

Let $\mean_1$ and $\mean_0$ be the mean cholesterol
of men who do and do not have a CHD event by 1969,
in the population the WCGS sampled.
A comparison of the two groups
tests the null hypothesis that the means are equal
against the [two-sided alternative](#def-two-sided-alternative) that they differ:

$$H_0: \mean_1 = \mean_0 \qquad H_1: \mean_1 \ne \mean_0$$
:::
